violations.text: Raw animal foods such as raw shelled eggs were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as plantains and vegetables in the reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Rodenticide was observed bare in various places during time of inspection. Rodent bait shall be contained in a covered, tamper-resistant bait station. PIC informed. Bare rodenticide was removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in storage area have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. Areas to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Opening was observed by door in kitchen. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
